one_sentence_claim: A truthful action-only contributor breaks joint counterfactual coupling across branches while preserving one-step branch marginals, inducing planner failure via inconsistent branch comparison.
threat_operation: Injecting legally valid action sequences across overlapping multi-agent or shared-environment trajectories to induce latent non-identifiability / spurious branch dependency without perturbing individual marginal predictive distributions.
invariant: Joint counterfactual consistency / conditional cross-branch invariance under intervened action sequences from shared latent initializations.
exact_short_gate: TD-MPC2 (common/world_model.py, WorldModel.forward) and MBRL-Lib/PETS (mbrl/models/gaussian_mlp.py) parameterize transitions as deterministic functions z_{t+1} = T(z_t, a_t) or independent diagonal Gaussian marginals p(s_{t+1}|s_t, a_t). In both codebases, conditioning on identical z_t / s_t strictly forces p(s_{t+1}|s_t, a) to be identical regardless of whether another branch a' was evaluated; the architectures lack cross-branch covariance heads or joint multi-action distribution modeling. Evaluating cross-branch counterfactual discrepancy reduces to evaluating individual marginal errors.
positive_controls: Matched permutation control: Shuffle action sequences across branches to isolate joint dependence from marginal frequency shifts.
Decoupled transition baseline: Fit independent models per discrete action branch to demonstrate identical marginal degradation without joint latent coupling.
nearest_prior_art: Pearl's causal ladder / Counterfactual Consistency in MBRL (e.g., ACID, CoCo, and structural causal model identifiability literature)
why_not_generic: It targets the failure of counterfactual ranking rather than single-step prediction loss, but collapses back into generic model underfitting/misspecification in standard architectures.
decision: Reject. The proposal cannot clear Novelty >= 7.0 for two structural reasons: First, standard world models (TD-MPC2, PETS, Dreamer) evaluate transition dynamics factorized point-wise per action (z_{t+1} = f(z_t, a)); by mathematical construction, if the one-step marginals p(s_{t+1}|s_t, a) are individually calibrated and consistent for all a, the joint counterfactual distribution over branches given identical s_t is trivially fixed and cannot be selectively desynchronized without perturbing either the marginals or the shared state encoder. Second, in repositories lacking structural causal graphs or joint multi-branch heads, breaking 'counterfactual coupling' without altering single-step marginals is either mathematically impossible or identical to generic epistemic uncertainty / out-of-distribution generalization error under branch-selection planners. No repository carrier supports a two-minute gate demonstrating this divergence.
